Image of Daring Heart holding documents (prop1156_00)

Are those refreshments? As long as they're from the heart,
anything you bring is welcome!

*pant, pant, pant*!
...Not yet... I can still... keep going—!

Peace of mind breeds peak performance.
It's the very stepping stone needed to reach where you strive to be.

Nice... You look like you're really enjoying that.
See? Nothing to be afraid of, right?
I'll make an all-out pitch with all the research I've gathered—!
...I see. I'm glad. You actually remembered, didn't you?

—CHOMP! Nom, nom, nom...
So that they can move with lightning speed only at the exact instant they strike their prey♪

Because thanks to you, I feel like I can fly so much higher.
Far, far higher... than when I was all on my own.

A leopard gecko, huh? Part of it is because they're nocturnal, but...
they don't waste a single movement.
...Wait, huh—

Staying calm this time, I gently reach out with warmth and affection,
making sure not to show any hostility...
You even went out of your way to look up what I like...—

Steeling my resolve, I reach toward a frilled lizard
that looks relatively docile—and the moment I do, its frill flares wide open!
...Huh?
"Expected to compensate for physical handicaps."

Wait, wait, wait a second!
Hold on...!

Listen, I have to keep pushing forward. Pump my legs, rack my brain,
at a speed no one can overtake... forward, forward—forward!

Let's go, right now.
You're stuck with me now! Naturally, you're coming with me too!
So with that said, sorry, but I'm getting back to training!

Hehe... It's okay, it's not scary in the least.
Come on! Show me your daring heart!

To think you'd track down such an obscure article...
Hehe... Your passion completely won me over!

! Ahaha... Are you just forgetful by nature?
I told you the other day, but... fine, I'll teach you as many times as it takes.
(Conserving energy... so she can unleash explosive power when the moment comes...?)
Amazing! Thanks to that... I feel like my eyes have been opened!
Hey, I really am... definitely going to win the mock race.

...No, it's not that. ...The only time I ever mentioned liking reptiles
was in one single old magazine interview.

Sharpening your claws constantly won't get you to the main course.
Ah, you're right... Yes, exactly, I need to...—

You gathered your courage and stepped into my world.
You're the very first person... to ever do so much just for me.
Hehe... Yes... truly.

She must be pushing herself to the absolute limit. Driving her legs on sheer willpower,
her running form looked like it was on the verge of falling apart.

Putting together something so detailed... must have been grueling, right?
Gathering all this data and running the analysis had to have taken an immense amount of time...

You're okay... Don't be afraid. Just stay calm and touch them gently.
I know your kind heart will get through to them...

What's all this? ...A training menu for the mock race?
And over here, analytical data on Craft and the others... plus a schedule...
Urgh...—

Look, this ball python is super calm, see?
Its skin feels delightfully cool, too... Good boy...! This is the absolute best...!
Wow! Amazing!

What's wrong? Did your feet grow roots or something?
Don't just freeze up by the entrance—come closer and take a good look♪

As I watch her, my eyes suddenly catch sight
of a gecko sitting completely motionless.

(Being tense all the time... stays wound tight without ever generating maximum spring.
I see, so that's how it works...)

The moment we arrive at the cafe, Daring Heart's eyes light up
as she goes around adoring every reptile in the store.
Oh my... All right, all right. I surrender!

Isn't that a complimentary coupon for a reptile cafe...!
I mean, sure, I like them... I love them, but still!

...This little one isn't just standing still, either.
It's honing its focus. All for the defining moment that's bound to come.

Look at the glossy sheen on this green iguana's scales...!
It's practically a jewel...! So cool!

Daring Heart agreed to take a break.
I savor the joy of knowing my desperate proposal made a difference.

You really are... a wonderful Trainer!
And quirky, too... Hehe, you never fail to keep things interesting.

After enjoying everything to the fullest... I check on that gecko
that first caught my eye. —Sure enough, it's still completely motionless.
..."The Correlation Between Relaxation and Explosive Top Speed"?

"By reducing air resistance and shedding unnecessary movements,
energy explodes at the moment of impact. Consequently—"

Oh! You were watching me again♪ Got any advice for me?
I'm planning to run one more rep, so even afterwards—
